data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at the start of the year was USD 727.385m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening of approximately USD 54.0m (7.4% of opening gross claims), predominantly arising from deterioration on older accident years. The report identifies COVID-19 business interruption losses and an elevated North Atlantic hurricane season as primary drivers of adverse results in 2020; the reinsurance-to-close transfers into Syndicate 1686 during the year also materially affect comparability of reserve movements. No single quantified gross prior-year movement by line is disclosed in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: The primary drivers of the adverse result are losses arising from the COVID-19 pandemic, principally losses arising from business interruption in our property portfolio, and an elevated level of losses resulting from natural catastrophes, principally from the North Atlantic hurricane season.

Following the closure of Syndicate 2007 and Syndicate 6129 effective 31 December 2020, the assets and liabilities of Syndicate 2007 transferred into Syndicate 1686 as part of a planned reinsurance to close transaction.

Included within net outstanding claims of USD 774.1m (2019: USD 438.1m) is a decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2019 and prior years of account of USD 145.2m (2019: decrease in outstanding claims relating to 2018 and prior years of account USD 77.0m).
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was derived from the published gross cumulative claims development triangle (page 17) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2019 and 2020). The year-end 2020 RITC transfers (Syndicate 2007 and 6129) are disclosed in the report and may distort the claims triangle and movement comparability. The report explicitly states a net release (after reinsurance) relating to 2019 and prior years of USD 145.2m, but a gross prior-year movement is not stated; the gross PYD above is triangle-derived and therefore moderate confidence is applied.
